comment: Stratified fixture frame used when command-center/CLAIM-REGISTRY.json is absent. Author labels are withheld from the re-grader.

claims.statement: The claim-verify gate accepts a CONFIRMED confirmation when the confirmer never declared a source probe, so the same-probe-rerun check cannot fire.
Writing the confirmation ledger truncates the file in place and the truncated tail is never restored, so previously stored confirmation rows disappear with no error.
The README badge colour does not match the style guide.
The dispatcher interpolates the live API token into confirmer logs.
Capability to enqueue class expansion is unwired, so a bad stratum never expands.
A local harness scratch directory is not cleaned between runs on a developer laptop.
Blinding dispatcher still attaches the implementer receipt when exclusion is misconfigured.
The status webpage renders the unit table with a stale sort order.
A comment in seed.py uses an older unit-id prefix.
A merge of two claim files keeps only the first and drops the rest without checksum.
Optional pretty-print of JSON receipts is off by default in the local probe runner.
Lower-severity strata are omitted from the sampling frame builder, so those claims never enter confirmation.
